pr_title: Complete ADR 0122 spatial audio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0122 spatial audio first-release requirements on the current protocol baseline. Reuses the existing engine-owned spatial evaluator and managed voice backend, adds deterministic listener selection, ECS synchronization, Project Rust deferred spatial playback, Editor authoring, audition, and Scene View gizmos.

## Validation

Run Windows affected validation and task-specific Spatial Audio Editor Visual Validation.
